text:
Entanglement usually gets top billing in quantum computing, but quantum contextuality, the idea that properties don't have fixed values independent of how you measure them, may be the deeper reason quantum computers can outperform classical ones.

Today on the cover of @ScienceMagazine, we put contextuality to work on our Willow quantum processor:

- won the "impossible" magic square game 98.3% of the time (classical limit: 88.9%)
- measured a 5.59 on state-independent contextuality tests (classical bound: 4, quantum max: 6)
- beat classical strategies in multiplayer games up to 71 qubits
- ran a landmark shallow-circuit algorithm at scale for the first time - up to 105 qubits

These tasks also catch subtle hardware errors random benchmarks miss, a sharper ruler for building better quantum systems.
zh: 皮查伊：称量子语境性或才是量子计算机超越经典计算机的更深原因；谷歌用Willow处理器相关实验登上《科学》封面，包括最高105量子比特的浅层电路算法等。

text: On Starship’s 15th flight last week, the Super Heavy booster correctly performed a safe abort when returning for a catch and ended its mission with a splashdown in the water off the coast of Starbase. Following splashdown, SpaceX recovery teams were immediately onsite to safe the area while our Environmental Health and Safety team worked to ensure any debris that washes onshore was recovered. When we received reports of potential debris in Mexican territory, we immediately mobilized to send specialists to aid in identification and lead any cleanup work required. Partners on the ground relayed that they have found very little debris in their sweeps of the beach, and the small amount they have found are not clearly from SpaceX operations. The majority of the social media posts online claiming widespread debris and damage are either outright fabrications or intentionally misleading. Independent tests confirm materials inside Starship and the Super Heavy booster pose no chemical, biological, or toxicological risks.
zh: SpaceX：星舰第15次飞行中，超重型助推器在返回捕捉时执行安全中止并在星基海岸附近溅落；回收团队已到场处理，并称针对墨西哥境内残骸传闻已派人协助辨认清理，多数社交媒体相关说法不实，材料检测显示无毒理风险。

text:
Remarks from Anthropic CEO @DarioAmodei on our initial public offering:

My co-founders and I started Anthropic because we believe that the most powerful technology of our time should be built for the benefit of humankind. I believe sufficiently powerful AI, working in concert with humans, could compress a century of scientific and medical progress into a decade. At the same time, we have always been honest that this technology has very real risks. And to state it unequivocally, we will pace the training and deployment of AI systems, taking as long as is necessary to have confidence that they are safe and will remain under human control. We will not bend to either business or political pressure. Today puts the company in a stronger financial position, and in doing so only strengthens our resolve to do the right thing.
zh: 阿莫代伊：就Anthropic IPO发表讲话，称创立公司是为了让当代最强大的技术造福人类；认为足够强大的人工智能可与人协作，将百年科学与医学进步压缩到十年，并强调不会向商业或政治压力让步，将按安全节奏训练和部署系统。
